# balena_application_profile (Resource)

Manages a Balena application profile, linking a fleet application to a host application via a profile name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_application_profile" "example" {
  application_id = balena_application.fleet.id
  host_app_id    = data.balena_application.host.id
  profile_name   = "my-profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the fleet application.
- `host_app_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the host application.
- `profile_name` (String) Profile name (1–100 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the application profile.
